title: Canonical evaluation of source-site derived Isom sheaves
statement: For a scheme X and a commutative ring B in Type(u+1), identify the slice-site and actual-source-site local derived Isom presheaves naturally, and hence identify their sheafifications [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison]. For any derived module sheaves A,D on X_et, an affine weakly contractible U in X_proet, and a section s over U of the comparison inverse image of the source-site Isom sheaf, define sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation(s) as an actual isomorphism between localProEtaleComparison(U.hom,B)(A) and localProEtaleComparison(U.hom,B)(D). The map is the comparison-slice evaluation transported through the localization equivalence [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. There is no boundedness, finite-coefficient or nonempty-stalk hypothesis. The inverse of the pro-etale sheafification unit is unique; no arbitrary witness is chosen.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 0F63; localization of etale and pro-etale sites, Tags 098K and 094T.

proof.text: Construct the source/slice sheaf equivalences by the etale over-site equivalence and pro-etale weakly-etale localization. Their functors are additive sectionwise. Derive their exact equivalences and their comparison with the canonical inverse-image functors.

For a morphism of etale objects, the localization comparison is the identity on sections. The upperStar composition coherence gives the underived path equation. Functoriality of mapDerivedCategory transports it to derived categories. Conjugating local isomorphisms by that equation proves naturality. Full faithfulness supplies the inverse, giving an isomorphism of Isom presheaves and hence of sheafifications.

Transport the section along the inverse sheaf isomorphism and comparison pullback. Apply derivedIsoEvaluation, which uses the uniquely invertible pro-etale sheafification unit on weakly contractible affines. Map the resulting actual isomorphism through the pro-etale localization equivalence and conjugate by the derived restriction comparison. Its endpoints are precisely localProEtaleComparison.

def sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation
    (A D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (U : X.ProEt) (ha : IsAffine U.left)
    (hU : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} U)
    (s : ((comparisonSetUpperStar X).obj
      (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf A D)).obj.obj (op U)) :
    (localProEtaleComparison U.hom B).obj A ≅
      (localProEtaleComparison U.hom B).obj D
